page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 12 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing 12 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and does not include any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile. Single-core processing is a weak point, with stress-ng single-core performance scoring 1107.38 (bottom 25%) and single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor at 19.09 GB/sec (bottom 10%). However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 8800.46 and a PassMark CPU score of 10233.84. Memory bandwidth remains average, with read-only small block speeds reaching 492.04 GB/sec and large block writes at 50.4 GB/sec. PassMark memory performance is weak, scoring 1749.38.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. It is suitable for multi-threaded batch processing, basic database operations (PassMark database operations scored an average 3321.04), and Redis key-value stores, where it achieves an average of 8.46 million SET operations per second. It is less suitable for memory-intensive applications, single-threaded tasks, or large-scale LLM inference, where the 7B model prompt processing drops to a poor 15.22 tokens/second. Qualitatively, it offers dedicated CPU allocation for legacy enterprise workloads seeking dedicated resources without the overhead of high-capacity memory.
